summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) Dashboard EnergyFlow hover inspector and (2) Geräte doc-diff. All 6 targeted scenarios PASS. Inspector shows correct title + all required metric rows for flow-battery/flow-grid/flow-pv/flow-house and hides on mouse-away. Doc-diff: shelly card shows '1 geändert' chip, time-line '1 Wert(e) geändert', Firmware-Version row shows 'geändert' badge with 'vorher: 1.4.2'. Unchanged devices (ahoy/trucki/victron) show time-line without 'geändert' and no diff chip. Clicking Erkennen on shelly resets chip and switches time-line to 'unverändert seit letztem Scan'. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow on Dashboard or Geräte (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flow inspector overlay works via real Playwright hover (not visible in static screenshots). Doc-diff requires checking shelly chip BEFORE clicking Erkennen since re-scan resets changed_count to 0.
